### 📋 Menu Summary(Scaled for 6 Guests — 100% Dairy-Free)

1. **Mezze & Starters:**- **Charred Eggplant Dip (*Melitzanosalata*) & Silky Garlic Hummus:** Topped with extra virgin oliveoil, sumac, za'atar, and toasted pine nuts.
   - **Warm Grilled Pita Flatbreads:** Brushedwith olive oil and wild oregano.
   - **Marinated Aegean Olives & Capers:** Kalamata & Castelvetrano oliveswith citrus peel and herbs.
2. **Main Course:**
   - **Grilled Lemon-Herb Chicken Souvlaki Skewers:**Tender chicken marinated in cold-pressed olive oil, fresh lemon juice, garlic, wild Greek oregano, and thyme, skewered with sweet bell peppers and red onions.
3. **Dairy-Free Sides & Salads:**
   - **Crispy Greek Lemon-Oregano Roasted Potatoes (*Patates Lemonates*):** Yukon Gold wedges braised in lemon,garlic, and broth, roasted until golden and crisp-edged.
   - **Traditional Greek Village Salad (*Horiatiki* — Dairy-Free):** Ripe vine tomatoes, Persian cucumbers, red onion, Kalamata olives, and caperberries tossed in EVOO and red wine vinegar.
   - **Herbed Jeweled Couscous Salad:** Fluffycouscous with fresh mint, parsley, toasted pistachios/pine nuts, and sweet pomegranate arils.
4. **Dessert & Refreshments:**
   - **Citrus Olive Oil Cake:** Fragrant dairy-free sponge finished with fresh orange zest.- **Beverages:** Greek Assyrtiko white wine & sparkling water infused with fresh mint, cucumber, and lemon.

---### 🛒 Categorized Shopping List Highlights

- **Meat & Poultry:** Boneless/skinless chicken thighs or breasts(3.5 lbs / 1.6 kg).
- **Fresh Produce:** Lemons (6–8), Garlic (2 heads), Yukon Gold potatoes (3 lbs), Vine tomatoes (2 lbs), Persian cucumbers (5–6),Red & green bell peppers, Red onions (3), Eggplants (2), Fresh parsley, Mint, Thyme, andPomegranate arils.
- **Pantry, Grains & Bakery:** Pita flatbreads (6–8 count), Couscous, Pine nuts / Pistachios, Bamboo/metal skewers.
- **Canned & Jarred:** Kalamata olives(pitted), Capers/caper berries, Low-sodium vegetable broth, Classic hummus (dairy-free), Tahini.- **Oils, Vinegars & Spices:** Extra virgin olive oil, Red wine vinegar, Dried Greek oregano, Sweet paprika, Za'atar, Sea salt, and Black peppercorns.

Dairy-Free):** Ripe vine tomatoes, crisp Persian cucumbers, thinly sliced red onions, Kalamata olives, caper berries, and fresh flat-leaf parsley tossed with extra virgin olive oil and red wine vinegar *(feta-free / dairy-free)*. +- **Herbed Jeweled Couscous Salad:** Fluffy couscous tossed with fresh mint, parsley, chopped pistachios, sweet pomegranate arils, and a zesty lemon-dijon vinaigrette. + +### Dessert & Refreshments +- **Orange Blossom & Citrus Olive Oil Cake:** Moist, fragrant dairy-free sponge finished with fresh orange zest and powdered sugar. +- **Beverage Pairings:** + - *Wine:* Crisp, mineral-driven Greek Assyrtiko (Santorini) or crisp Sauvignon Blanc. + - *Non-Alcoholic:* Sparkling water infused with fresh mint, cucumber ribbons, and crushed Meyer lemon. + +--- + +## 👨‍🍳 Recipes & Execution (Scaled for 6) + +### 1. Grilled Lemon-Herb Chicken Souvlaki Skewers +- **Prep time:** 20 mins | **Marinate:** 2–6 hours | **Cook time:** 12–15 mins +- **Ingredients:** + - 3.5 lbs (1.6 kg) Boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1.25-inch cubes + - 1/3 cup Extra virgin olive oil + - 1/4 cup Fresh lemon juice (about 2 large lemons) + zest of 1 lemon + - 6 cloves Garlic, finely minced + - 1.5 tbsp Dried Greek oregano (or wild mountain oregano) + - 1 tbsp Fresh thyme leaves, chopped + - 1 tsp Sweet paprika + - 1.5 tsp Sea salt + - 1 tsp Freshly cracked black pepper + - 2 Red bell peppers and 2 red onions, cut into 1.25-inch chunks (for skewering) + - 12 Bamboo or stainless steel skewers (soak bamboo skewers in water for 30 mins) +- **Method:** + 1. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, oregano, thyme, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a large glass bowl or zip-top bag. + 2. Add chicken cubes and massage marinade thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 6 hours. + 3. Thread alternating pieces of marinated chicken, red onion, and bell pepper onto skewers (approx. 5–6 pieces of chicken per skewer). + 4. Preheat grill (or indoor cast iron grill pan) to medium-high heat (400°F–425°F / 205°C–220°C) and lightly oil the grates. + 5. Grill skewers for 12–15 minutes, turning every 3–4 minutes until all sides have nice grill marks and internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). + 6. Transfer to a serving platter, tent loosely with foil, and rest for 5 minutes. Garnish with lemon wedges and fresh parsley before serving. + +--- + +### 2. Greek Lemon-Oregano Roasted Potatoes (*Patates Lemonates*) +- **Prep time:** 15 mins | **Cook time:** 50–60 mins | **Oven:** 400°F (200°C) +- **Ingredients:** + - 3 lbs (1.4 kg) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into thick wedges + - 1/3 cup Extra virgin olive oil + - 1/2 cup Low-sodium vegetable broth (or chicken stock) + - 1/3 cup Fresh lemon juice (about 2 large lemons) + - 5 cloves Garlic, pressed or grated + - 1.5 tbsp Dried Greek oregano + - 1 tsp Semolina or cornstarch (secret for extra crisp edges) + - 1.5 tsp Kosher salt & 1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper +- **Method:** + 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). + 2. In a large roasting pan, whisk together olive oil, vegetable broth, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, semolina/cornstarch, salt, and pepper. + 3. Add potato wedges and toss thoroughly to coat in a single layer. + 4. Roast uncovered for 45–55 minutes, flipping wedges halfway through, until liquid has reduced and potatoes are golden-brown and crisp on the edges with tender, creamy centers. + +--- + +### 3. Traditional Greek Village Salad (*Horiatiki* - Dairy-Free) +- **Prep time:** 15 mins | **Chilling:** 10 mins +- **Ingredients:** + - 2 lbs Ripe vine-ripened or heirloom tomatoes, cut into bite-sized wedges + - 4 Persian cucumbers (or 1 large English cucumber), sliced into half-moons + - 1/2 Medium red onion, thinly sliced into half-rings + - 1 Green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips + - 3/4 cup Pitted Kalamata olives + - 2 tbsp Capers or caper berries, drained + - 1/4 cup Extra virgin olive oil (high quality, cold pressed) + - 2 tbsp Red wine vinegar + - 1 tsp Dried oregano + - 1/2 tsp Sea salt flakes and freshly cracked pepper to taste +- **Method:** + 1. In a wide salad bowl, combine tomatoes, cucumbers, sliced red onion, bell pepper, Kalamata olives, and capers. + 2. In a small bowl, whisk extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and black pepper. + 3. Pour dressing over the salad just before serving; toss gently to combine and let juices meld. + +--- + +### 4. Herbed Jeweled Couscous Salad +- **Prep time:** 15 mins | **Cook time:** 5 mins | **Servings:** 6 +- **Ingredients:** + - 1.5 cups Dry couscous (or pearl/Israeli couscous) + - 1.5 cups Boiling vegetable broth + - 1/3 cup Pine nuts or chopped pistachios, lightly toasted + - 1/2 cup Fresh pomegranate arils + - 1/2 cup Flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped + - 1/3 cup Fresh mint leaves, finely chopped + - 3 tbsp Extra virgin olive oil + - 2 tbsp Fresh lemon juice + - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste +- **Method:** + 1. Place couscous in a heatproof bowl, pour boiling broth over top, cover tightly with a plate or wrap, and let stand for 5–7 minutes. + 2. Fluff couscous with a fork and let cool to room temperature. + 3. Fold in chopped herbs, toasted nuts, pomegranate seeds, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Serve warm or chilled. + +--- + +### 5. Dairy-Free Mezze Trio (Hummus, Melitzanosalata, Warm Flatbread) +- **Ingredients:** + - 1 tub (12 oz) High-quality classic tahini hummus (or homemade with chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon, and olive oil) + - 2 Medium globe eggplants (roasted whole until charred, flesh scooped and mashed with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 clove garlic, 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt, and parsley) + - 1 pack (6–8 count) Pita flatbreads + - Extra virgin olive oil and za'atar / smoked paprika for garnish +- **Method:** + 1. Spread hummus and eggplant dip into shallow serving bowls; drizzle generously with olive oil and dust with za'atar or paprika. + 2. Brush pita breads with olive oil, warm on the grill or skillet for 1 minute per side, slice into triangles, and serve alongside dips. + +--- + +## ⏱️ Prep & Cooking Timeline + +| Time Window | Tasks & Milestones | +| :--- | :--- | +| **Morning / 4–6 hrs Ahead** | • Dice chicken and place into lemon-herb marinade in refrigerator.
• Roast and prepare *Melitzanosalata* (eggplant dip) and chill.
• Toast pine nuts/pistachios; chop fresh herbs (parsley, mint). | +| **2 Hours Ahead** | • Cut potatoes and arrange in roasting pan with lemon-broth mixture.
• Chop salad vegetables (tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers) and keep separated in a bowl.
• Thread chicken skewers onto skewers and let sit at cool room temp 20 mins before cooking. | +| **1 Hour Ahead** | • Preheat oven to 400°F and put potatoes in to roast.
• Cook and fluff couscous; fold in herbs, pomegranate, and dressing.
• Set table, chill wine, prepare mint-cucumber sparkling water. | +| **25 Minutes Ahead** | • Preheat outdoor grill or indoor grill pan.
• Toss Greek salad with dressing. | +| **15 Minutes Ahead** | • Grill chicken skewers (12–15 mins total).
• Warm pita on grill.
• Plate dips in bowls with olive oil and spices. | +| **Serving Time** | • Pull roasted potatoes from oven, transfer chicken to warm platter with fresh lemon wedges, and serve family-style! | + +--- +
